rows.said: Haan didi, main ready hoon. Mujhe lagta hai dabbe mein zyada corners hote hain.
rows.heard: दीदी, मैं ready हूँ। मुझे लगता है डब्बे में ज्यादा corners होते हैं।
rows.reply: Cricket kit ke tiffin box mein corners ginoge ya faces? Apna guess batao; ant mein Golu ko sikhana hai.

rows.said: Achha, toh dabbe ki flat side ko face kehte hain?
rows.heard: दोनों बेक की स्लैब साइड को फेस कहते हैं?
rows.reply: Haan, box ki har flat surface ko face kehte hain; do faces milne wali line edge hoti hai. Box ke do faces milne par kya banta hai?

rows.said: Haan, samajh gaya. Do faces jahan milte hain woh edge hai.
rows.heard: हाँ, समझ गया। दो faces जहाँ मिलते हैं, वो edge है।
rows.reply: Bilkul, do faces milne par edge banti hai. Matchbox cuboid hai; iske faces count karne ke liye kaun-kaun si sides ginoge?

rows.said: Achha, aur corner woh point hai na jahan edges milte hain?
rows.heard: अच्छा, और कौन सा वो point है जहां edges मिलते हैं?
rows.reply: Edges jahan milti hain, us point ko corner ya vertex kehte hain. Matchbox mein top par kitne corners hote hain?

rows.said: Achha, toh dabbe ki flat side ko face kehte hain?
rows.heard: अच्छा, तो डब्बे की फ्लैट साइड को फेस कहते हैं?
rows.reply: Haan, dabbe ki flat side ko face kehte hain. Dice ek cube hota hai. Iske kitne flat faces hain?
Aarav, tumne “faces” kaha—ab dice ke saare flat faces gin kar batao: kitne hain?
Aarav, dice ke 6 flat faces ginne ka step bilkul sahi hai. Ab cube ke corners gin kar batao—kitne?

rows.said: Achha, toh dabbe ki flat side ko face kehte hain?
rows.heard: अच्छा, तो डब्बे की फ्लैट साइड को फेस कहते हैं।
rows.reply: Haan, dabbe ki har flat side ko face kehte hain. Dice ki picture dekho. Tumhe 3 faces dikh rahe hain. Poore dice mein total kitne faces hain?

rows.said: Kyunki maine har taraf gina, upar neeche, aage peeche, daayen baayen.
rows.heard: क्योंकि मैंने हर तरफ गिना. ऊपर नीचे, आगे पीछे, दाएँ बाएँ.
rows.reply: Dabbe pe ungli wahan chalao jahan do faces milte hain. Woh line face hai, edge hai, ya corner?

rows.reply: Corner ek point hota hai; do faces milne wali line par ungli chalao. Line face, edge, ya corner?
Aarav, tumne “edge” naam pehchana. Ab sticks aur clay ki goliyon se cube ka dhaancha banate hain. Sticks edges hain aur goliyan corners. Kitni sticks aur kitni goliyan chahiye?
